meta.title: Translation Check Lab: practice and human-review training
meta.description: Practice lab and human-review training environment for checking humanitarian SMS translations
lang.notice: French prepared with machine assistance; not yet reviewed by a professional translator.
hero.title: Translation Check Lab
hero.practiceNotice: It is a practice lab, not a translation service, and it never approves a message.
hero.subtitle: Machine translation can help draft, but a message that affects safety, health or access to aid needs a qualified bilingual person to check it before it is sent.
hero.kitLink: Part of the Humanitarian AI Training Kit (Session 2)
scope.title: Scope
scope.body: SMS is not confidential. Use this lab only for broadcast messages to groups, never for messages about an individual person.
variety.title: Language variety
variety.body: French differs across Canada, Europe and West and Central Africa. Arabic ranges from Modern Standard Arabic to local varieties that OPUS-MT may not match. Consider audio or visual channels alongside SMS for people with low literacy.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Text is processed locally by this application. When you choose model download, your browser retrieves model files from the listed third-party hosts. Text is not sent to those hosts by this application.
limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.body: OPUS-MT quality varies by language and domain. Back-translation can hide errors and invent new ones. Automated checks catch only specific surface changes. No tool replaces a qualified translator or community review.
limitations.checks: Pattern checks are intentionally conservative and produce false positives. They are prompts for human review, not accuracy measurements.
limitations.examples: Examples of false alarms: a correctly translated French word such as "minutes" flagged as untranslated; a capitalised place name such as "Well 12" flagged when only the capital letter changed in back-translation.
limitations.tatoeba: Tatoeba test sentences are short, general-domain sentences, not humanitarian or medical text, so these scores do not transfer to emergency messages.
pairs.title: Published model quality by language pair
pairs.intro: Benchmark scores are quoted exactly from each upstream OPUS-MT model card on Hugging Face. They are not a guarantee for your message.
practice.title: Practice mode
practice.intro: Review illustrative translations of synthetic humanitarian messages. Mark what is wrong and whether it is safe to send, then compare with the answer key.
practice.synthetic: SYNTHETIC training exercise only. Illustrative translations.
practice.backWarning: Back-translation can hide real errors. It is never proof that a message is safe to send.
practice.errors: What is wrong? (select all that apply)
practice.error.times: Times or dates changed or ambiguous
practice.error.contact: Phone, code or URL not preserved
practice.error.instructions: Action instruction lost (boil, call, go, etc.)
check.title: Check my own text
check.intro: Paste a short source message and its translation. Run meaning-risk checks without or with optional on-device machine translation.
check.liveIntro: Download an OPUS-MT model to translate and back-translate in your browser. Approximate quantized download:
check.modelFailed: Model could not load. Pattern checks below still run on text you entered.
check.modelTimeout: Model made no progress for 60 seconds. Pattern checks below still run on text you entered.
check.arInstructionNote: For Arabic, instructions are checked on the English back-translation only.
check.flagsSummary: {count} meaning-risk flags. See the list below.
check.backWarning: Back-translation is a warning signal only, not proof. A matching back-translation can hide a real error in the target language.
check.qualityWarning: This language pair has weak published benchmark scores. Do not rely on machine translation without expert human review.
check.noFlags: No automated flags detected. A human reviewer must still complete the review record before sending.
check.smsIntro: Characters outside GSM 03.38 force UCS-2 encoding (70/67 per segment), including typographic apostrophes (for example in French l'eau) and letters such as ê or ô.
check.replaceQuotes: Replace typographic quotes with plain ones
check.replaceQuotesHint: You must accept this change; it is never applied automatically.
check.replaceQuotesConfirm: Replace typographic quotes and apostrophes with plain ASCII quotes in this field?
check.reviewDisclaimer: Complete this record before copying final text. The software does not approve messages. No names are stored.
check.community.from: I am from the affected community
check.community.checked: I have checked with community members
check.editedText: Final edited text (if approving with edits)
check.copyLocked: Complete the review record to unlock Copy final text.
check.copyReady: Review record complete. You may copy final text.
check.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy manually.
check.unsaved: You have unsaved review work. Leave anyway?
